The plan below uses only car2. Car1 is stuck at Panchakanya shelter, since both of its roads are damaged. Tarkeshwar care home has no usable road, so its 3 injured and 3 elderly are deferred. Car2 makes four round trips from Myagang hospital: three to Kakani market and one each to the Kalika and Jwalamukhi cluster. The last trip also picks up the Shivapuri adult. Deferring Naukunda's 3 adults (60) is cheaper than the 152-minute round trip needed to reach them.
